$comment: The pin page (/pin/; /contributors/ redirects here). Summarises the recognition system draft (design/research/recognition-system.md) for the public: anyone can contribute; role buttons are Trained, a brass rim marks a Practitioner; the Contributing Member pin starts at Reviewer, with backing plates for Committer and Maintainer; membership has two doors. Not board-approved: [PLACEHOLDER] marks what's still open. The register reads data/register.json.
title: The pin
description: The pin you can't buy. Earned from peers: two practices, two sponsors, one pin. How buttons, rims, pins and membership work at The Upskilling Labs.

hero.title: The pin you can't buy.
hero.lede: Earned from peers. Two practices. Two sponsors. One pin.
hero.alt: The pin: the orb mark with teal and red cat-eye enamel

open.title: Anyone can contribute.
open.body: Contributor isn't a rank. Improve a playbook, a flyer, or the code, and you're a contributor, credited by name. No gate, no sign-up.

tiers.title: Wear what you do.
tiers.lede: Every role at The Labs has its own button. When you've done the work, it gets a rim.

items.label: Trained
items.title: The button
items.body: Trained and seated in a role. Your coordinator or the role's lead hands it to you.

items.label: Practitioner
items.title: The rim
items.body: You've done the work. A brass rim goes around the same button, numbered to match your entry on the register.

tiers.builder: A Builder is an Upskiller with a brass rim.
tiers.mark: The rim is being prototyped. The picture is a sketch. [PLACEHOLDER]
tiers.buttonAlt: A role button: the orb mark on ink, ringed in white

ladder.title: One pin. Rank shows behind it.
ladder.lede: Every Contributing Member wears the same pin. A metal plate behind it marks each step up.

ranks.name: Reviewer
ranks.body: A Practitioner in two roles, sponsored by two people who already wear the pin, from different roles or Labs. Reviewers review work in the roles they've practised.

ranks.name: Committer
ranks.body: Has helped across every core area of The Labs. Committers approve work, within limits the board sets.

ranks.name: Maintainer
ranks.body: Sets direction for an area. Nominated by Maintainers, confirmed by the board.

ladder.metal: Brass for your region. Silver for national.
ladder.areasNote: The board sets the core areas. [PLACEHOLDER]

alt.committer: The pin on one metal backing plate
alt.maintainer: The pin on two stacked metal backing plates

membership.title: Two doors.
membership.lede: Support The Labs, or earn your way in. They're separate, and you can walk through both.

doors.name: Supporting Member
doors.how: Pay light dues, on a sliding scale, with a no-questions waiver.
doors.gets: The SUPPORTING MEMBER button, your entry on the register, and events.
doors.note: Dues: [PLACEHOLDER: $X a year, $75 at most]. Coming soon.

doors.name: Contributing Member
doors.gets: The pin, your entry on the register, and a voice in the practice you've earned.

rules: Dues never buy a rim, a pin, or a vote.
Paying isn't a step toward Reviewer, and Reviewers don't have to pay.

ceremony.title: Recorded first. Then the handshake.
ceremony.lede: The award goes on the register first. The pinning is at the next quarterly regional summit. [PLACEHOLDER: the run of show is a draft.]

moments.label: Your name
moments.body: Called out, with the roles you've practised.

moments.label: Your sponsors
moments.body: The two who vouched for you pin it on.

moments.label: One line
moments.body: They say, in a sentence, what you did.

moments.label: The register
moments.body: Your number, matched to the back of your pin.

seats.title: The rank is yours. Seats come and go.

items.title: Rank is permanent.
items.body: A pin records what you've done. It stays yours.

items.title: Seats carry the permissions.
items.body: Each Lab keeps as many active seats as the work needs. The register says who holds one now.

items.title: Emeritus is an honour.
items.body: Step back and you keep the rank, the title, and your voice. Come back to any open seat.

seats.exception: The one exception: a serious breach of the Code of Conduct.

register.title: Contributing Members.
register.empty: Nobody yet. The first pinning is at the next regional summit.
register.label: The register, {n} entries

items.a: No. Supporting Members pay dues and get their own button. The pin is only ever earned.
No. It's community recognition: The Labs saying you've done the work.
Brass is earned in your region. Silver is earned on national work.
You go emeritus. The rank and the pin are still yours.

join.title: Start with one button.
join.lede: Most people start as an ambassador. Ten minutes to get in.

footer.renders: Images of the button and pin are 3D renders, not photos. The rim and plates are sketches.
